name: Кабель сетевой готовый Nordost Red Dawn 16 Amp C19
descriptionHtml:
Кабель сетевой готовый Nordost Red Dawn 16 Amp C19 — Entry-level Leif-family AC power cord using FEP insulation and Nordost Micro Mono-Filament construction. Характеристики ниже — только с страницы/листа производителя.

  • Conductors: 3 × 12 AWG, 168-strand 99.9999% OFC
  • Insulation: Fluorinated ethylene propylene (FEP)
  • Capacitance: 8.5 pF/ft
  • Inductance: 0.121 μH/ft
  • DC resistance: 1.64 ohms per 1,000 ft

Характеристики производителя

Conductors: 3 × 12 AWG, 168-strand 99.9999% OFC · Insulation: Fluorinated ethylene propylene (FEP) · Capacitance: 8.5 pF/ft · Inductance: 0.121 μH/ft · DC resistance: 1.64 ohms per 1,000 ft · Terminations: US (NEMA), EU (Schuko), UK or AUS to IEC-C15 or IEC-C19.
